title: Prediction Suboptimality of the Lasso in Sparse Linear Regression
summary: The choice of the tuning parameter in the Lasso is central to its statistical performance in high-dimensional linear regression. In this work, we study tuning regimes under which the Lasso exhibits suboptimal prediction performance, in the sense that a simple refinement improves upon it both on high-probability events and in mean squared prediction error. Our analysis shows that the relevant stochastic scale is governed by Gaussian maxima on the selected or localized support, which may be more informative than the universal rate in Lasso theory.
